correctness.rationale: Inspected the exact Q(sqrt5) standalone enumeration and the full RESULT.md. At an edge-interior x the unique norming functional f_i forces y in the two unit directions ker(f_i). At a vertex x the norming functional interval gives x perpendicular_B y precisely when f_i(y)f_{i+1}(y)<=0; intersecting with decagon boundary yields 20 admissible subsegments. On every 1D case each norm is a maximum of ten affine terms, so the product is a quadratic on cells partitioned by all pairwise affine crossings. The exact checker checks endpoints and each interior stationary point using a rational quadratic-field arithmetic class, giving maximum P_edge=(63-5sqrt5)/16, P_vertex=(2+5sqrt5)/4, with strict difference (25sqrt5-55)/16>0. Independent numerical evaluation of the explicit pair and the respective edge/vertex maxima corroborated P_vertex~3.29508, P_edge~3.23873; finite exhaustive algorithm, not numeric sampling, is the claimed certificate. Birkhoff condition of witness verified using opposite signs of two norming functionals. The scope is precisely this affine-regular decagon and real scalars.
